title: Raised toast z-index can transiently cover consent banner buttons in the tiny-viewport corner, deviating from the binding "banner clickable at all times" guard
evidence:
With the customize panel open the banner is **666px tall — taller than the 480px
viewport** (its heading/body are clipped off-screen with or without any toast).
The banner's primary buttons therefore stop being bottom-aligned: they sit
clipped near the top of the viewport (y≈9–154) where the top-anchored toast
(y 80–152) lands. The toast is still visible (`toastVisible:true`, z 2147483001)
and transiently overlaps the "Reject all" / "Customize" / "Accept all" row for
its 5s lifetime (the toast is dismissible via its ✕ and auto-dismisses).
detail: Toast z-index (2147483001) outranks the consent banner; in the 320×480 expanded-panel corner it covers the banner's consent buttons for ≤5s, deviating from the binding "banner clickable at all times" guard. Bounded, dismissible, self-documented.
recommended_fix: When the banner's customize panel is open, drop the toast's z-index below the banner's (or reposition) so consent buttons stay clickable; accept the trade-off only where the banner exceeds the viewport.
